about: Coordinates measured from Yan Flash P2 diagrams for drawing. Same units as p1.json (arena radius 1, +x east, +y north). Every number is read from an image (never invented) and needs owner approval per scene.

measurement.base: Same 2000x2000 arena as P1: centre (1000,1000) px, radius 975 px; checked on yan-p2-07 (waymark A at 0.727 north, D at 0.722 west).

methods.auto: Yan's cyan player dot detected by colour (scripts/measure_dots.py), or a role icon (scripts/measure_yan.py).
methods.eye: Read by eye from a 1000 px view (±0.01).

measurement.sizes: Tower, stack, circle and bait radii read by eye from the drawn circles' edges (±0.01).

waymarks.note: Same values in all three images (±0.006).

p2-ultimate-embrace-1/buster.note: Loose spots from the owner: both tanks north, the party south, no set spots. The clip shows a red ring centred on the main tank (a splash shared by both tanks, as the videos say).

shapes.label: Ultimate Embrace: circle on the main-threat tank, shared by both tanks (size not measured)

Everyone stacks on one spot at max melee or a bit further: between the towers (Past's End) or opposite them (Future's End; run to the tower side once All Things Ending is cast). c.label: Example C
c.note: Built by us from the rules (not from a source): OT+H2 and D1+D3 start with the stacks, supports get cones; both stacks land on supports in set 5 and on DPS in set 7.

d.label: Example D
d.note: Built by us from the rules (not from a source): OT+H2 and D2+D4 start with the stacks, DPS get cones; both supports hold cones in set 2, so the melee swap happens there too.

groups.label: Tower turn
groups.note: Each soak turns the towers 45°, clockwise or anticlockwise at random; once the first set turns, every later set turns the same way (Yan; Kitten). Set 1 is drawn at south: our sources do not show where it really spawns.

groups.label: Example markers
groups.note: Who gets which spell is random. Yan's and Kitten's runs are copied from their pictures; C and D are built by us from the same rules. Method ② diagrams do not use this.

groups.label: Kefka's cast
groups.note: Past's End or Future's End: random each time, it decides where you bait All Things Ending. Shown the same for every bait here.
